subject: Logic
title: Logic in Conversations
description: A short lesson to help you apply Logic in Conversations.

hook.text: "You always do this!" is a claim. But is it accurate? Most arguments collapse under scrutiny.

buildup.text: Daily conversations are packed with hidden arguments—claims backed by unstated reasons.

discovery.text: "We should leave now because traffic builds at five." Premise: traffic at five. Conclusion: leave now.

twist.text: People rarely state all their premises. The hidden assumptions are where errors hide.

climax.text: Spotting the structure behind everyday claims turns messy debates into clear exchanges.

quiz.question: Why do everyday arguments often fail?
